URL Cleaner

A separate testing ground for seven experimental URL tools. Nothing here changes the stable build.

NIGHTLY LAB

Seven experiments are live

View nightly branch
DEV-1

Redirect unwrapping

Extract destinations from known redirect wrappers, locally and up to five layers.

DEV-2

URL X-Ray

Inspect the scheme, host, port, path, fragment, and every query parameter.

Included in Inspect URL
DEV-3

Tracking fingerprint

Count known tracking, affiliate, and redirect signals with a plain breakdown.

Shown after analysis
DEV-7

Encoded value decoder

Reveal encoded and double-encoded URL values without opening or fetching them.

Included in URL X-Ray
DEV-9

Aggressive cleaning

Optionally remove broader referral and tracking-like parameters.

DEV-11

Weirdness detector

Explain unusual URL structure without claiming that the URL is malicious.

Shown after analysis
DEV-12

Duplicate cleanup

Optionally remove only repeated identical name/value pairs. Leave off for signed URLs.
